到底是……账房低头一读，也忍不住放声大叫。
天呐，是石姑娘的下落！
石枣儿在赵州的石潭镇
——李进
冲出去的龙焱，正迫不及待喊人备车。
账房追在后边急问：“不是说好半年，现还差几天不是？”
“我等不及了，现在就算你拿铁链拴住我，我也非去不可。”龙焱转身望着账房，一双眼早都红了。“我保证会在最短时间内带枣儿回来，绝对不会延误九日后到醇王府烹馔的约定。”
当家都这么保证了，他这个当账房的除了点头，还能再说什么。“小的明白了，小的祝您一路平安。”
“龙爷，你的行囊。”小厮快步跑来。
龙焱看着账房点了下头，笑逐颜开。“等着办喜事吧！”
赵州石潭镇
一幢矮屋中响起一娇嫩唤声：“爹，我菜园忙去了。”
“记得回头多摘点荠菜。”
“知道了。”枣儿回道，同时拎起箩筐跟满水的木桶，一摇一晃来到屋旁的菜园。
半年前李进将枣儿跟她爹送上船，船一泊进指定处，便见一官差驾着马车等着，经过半日颠簸，马车就停在这赵州石潭镇。
虽然公主个性是娇蛮任性了点，但李进这人还真不恶，除了在船上递银票外，他还帮枣儿爷儿俩备好了小屋，屋旁还有一小块空地，初来乍到，枣儿恍恍惚惚以为自己又回到了家。
只是有个地方完全不一样，赵州这儿，没有她深受的龙焱。
在石潭镇，枣儿跟她爹以卖饺子、面疙瘩汤为生。虽说她离城时身边没多带盘缠，但凭着“一条龙”学来的手艺，个把月爷儿俩就攒了点钱，足够到镇上买些种子锄头回家耕种，如此施展，收入慢慢丰盈了些。
这会儿，只见她蹲在一大丛荠菜面前，双手像飞舞的蝶，一掐一捏摘着荠菜嫩枝，没一会儿积满了箩筐，屋里传来她爹乒乒乓乓的甩面声，她唇微微一勾，然后又敛住了笑。
“不知龙爷跟公主……两人处得好不好？”

她舀起一瓢水浇在泥地上，手指拨松方才弄乱的荠菜丛，接着又往下一畦菜移动。
半年过去了，枣儿眯着眼眺望远方树林，到现在忆起她与龙焱的最后一夜，仍旧会泪湿枕畔，她曾经冀望那一夜能让她怀上龙焱的孩子，但或许是她福薄，老天爷并未在她身上展现此等神迹。
“不管怎么样，我希望他们幸福，尤其是龙爷，能够放开心怀接纳公主。”
虽然公主出嫁天下大事，但枣儿一直当龙焱已跟普宁公主成亲，压根儿没想过其它可能；加上石潭镇僻静又小，平常外人不多，根本没什么人知道京里又有什么新消息。
石潭镇极好，邻人和蔼亲切，环境又清幽，她想在这儿一辈子住下去，不会有问题。就算偶尔思念来袭，她会凭着过去的点点滴滴，还有龙焱先前诉说过的爱语，咬紧牙，撑过去。
就在这时，一辆气派的马车辘辘驶进石潭镇，龙焱每过一条路，就下来打听附近有无一户姓石的父女，约半年前搬来，镇里人又不多，一下打听到枣儿跟她爹的住所。
在屋里甩面的石老庐听闻马车里甩面，以为是吃面疙瘩吃饺子的客人来早了，马上探头喊着——
“客倌还没呢！”可一见来人，他双眼倏地瞪大，他他他……不是他眼花了吧？“龙爷？！”
“您怎么还这么唤我？”龙焱朝石老爹恭敬一拜。“您早该改口唤我龙焱了。”
石老庐又哭又笑，手指正要指向屋旁菜园，可一想到公主，马上又紧抓着龙焱不放。“你先回答我，您跟公主……”
“皇上早把公主许配给别人，岳父大人放心，小婿身旁位子一直帮枣儿留着。”
“好、好，不枉费咱女儿一路为你哭了半年……”石老庐一揩泪。“今天咱饺子摊不营生了，全听你吩咐。”
龙焱按了按石老爹双手，立刻跑向菜园。
专心拔草的枣儿浑然不觉身后有人，直到察觉好像有人在看她，正欲转身，一双铁臂已牢牢将她抱住。
这气味，这感觉……枣儿猛地闭上眼，她想自己一定是搞错了，身旁人不可能是他，不可能是龙焱！
“我的枣儿。”心情激动的龙焱贴着她颊低喃道：“你可知这半年来，我想你想得多苦？”
“真的是您……”她头个反应是也是将他抱住，可一想起跟公主的约定，忙又使劲挣脱。
不能靠近他，万一被公主发现，会害了他的！枣儿噙着泪连连后退。
“我没有跟公主成亲，傻枣儿，你怎么会以为我放得下你？”
没有？！她瞠直了双眼。但是，当时公主确实跟她提过，她非嫁他不可呀……

“皇上将公主许配给别人了……”他一跨步再次抱紧她，哑着声音将这半年发生的事情约略说了一遍。“……除了发行跟李进的约定，我还一直不断写信请各地饭庄客栈的厨子帮忙留意你，可怎么知道，你这小家伙竟也自个儿开起小馆子来了。”[热X书%吧*独<家Y制@作]
“我不想忘了你教我的事嘛！”知道普宁公主已不再是两人的威胁，她紧搂着他放声大哭。积压了半年的想念与心酸一股脑儿爆发，她完全停不住眼泪。
“跟我回京。”他捧着她脸不断轻啄，一张脸早上分不清楚沾着是谁的眼泪。“你答应过我这辈子绝不离开我，我要你实现诺言，你非嫁我不可。”
“好、好，你说什么我都答应你……”
在她呢喃同意声中，龙焱将她打横抱起。
“跟我到我住的客栈去。”他冲着泪如雨下的枣儿笑道：“我接下来想做的事，不适宜被你爹撞见。”
“我爹……”她正想该跟她爹说一声，回头，便见她爹杵门边挥手。
“今天不营生，你们要上哪儿尽管去，老头全没意见。”
听见她爹这么一喊，两人同时笑了。
一路过来客栈的马车上，龙焱又详细补充了好多事。尤其她彻夜远走赵州那天，他简直要疯了。
“过去半年，苦了你了。”她轻挲着他脸颊。
“真正苦的是你，为什么要一个人暗地承担这么多事？要不是你爹知道该留信给我，或许我们现在还分隔两地，不得见面。”
“我是考虑到公主，若她今天真的跟你成了亲，你心里如果还惦着我，这样很不好。”
“傻子。”他佯怒轻拧她鼻。“只知道担心公主担心我，你自己呢？”
“我找不到其它更好的法子嘛！”她环着他颈脖嘤嘤哭着。“你不晓得那一天，我听李大人说你被公主关起来，我心里多难过。”
“你是想到我小时候？”他轻蹭着她脸。
她啜泣地点头。“我保护不了小时候的你，但至少，我可以让长大的人少捱一点苦……”
他紧紧环住她细腰。这丫头，总是让他心又疼又怜。
“对不起。”她诚挚道歉。“我当初说过不会再对你撒谎，但那天晚上，我还是犯了。”
“口说无凭。”他盯着她眼，一边吻去她颊边眼泪。“我要你用实际表现，补偿我这半年的相思之苦……”

她大着胆子吻上他嘴，犹然可以听见她模糊的喃喃：“过去那半年，我一直一直想起我们共度的那一夜……真的，好寂寞……”
“我也是。”他额贴着她额自承。
这半年来，他夜里每每睡不着，就会主的娇蛮任性，李进的固执，还有自己当初的愚昧与莽撞。但随着时间过去，他逐渐学人示苛责，只剩下对枣儿的爱怜。
content_en:
What is it... The accountant lowered his head to read and couldn't help shouting.
Oh my God, it’s Miss Shi’s whereabouts!
Shi Zaoer in Shitan Town, Zhaozhou
——Li Jin
Long Yan rushed out and couldn't wait to call someone to prepare the car.
The accountant chased after him and asked anxiously: "It was promised for half a year, but now it's still a few days away, isn't it?"
"I can't wait any longer. Even if you tie me up with an iron chain now, I have to go." Long Yan turned around and looked at the accounting room, his eyes already turning red. "I promise to bring Zao'er back as soon as possible, and I will never delay the appointment to cook at Prince Chun's Mansion in nine days."
The head of the house had given such a guarantee, so what else could he, the accountant, say besides nodding. "I understand, I wish you a safe journey."
"Master Long, your luggage." The boy came running quickly.
Long Yan looked at the accountant and nodded, smiling widely. "Waiting for a happy event!"
Shitan Town, Zhaozhou
A delicate voice called out from a low house: "Dad, I'm busy in the vegetable garden."
"Remember to pick more shepherd's purse later."
"I know." Zao'er replied, picking up the basket and the wooden bucket full of water at the same time, and staggered to the vegetable garden next to the house.
Half a year ago, Li Jin put Zaoer and her father on the boat. As soon as the boat docked at the designated place, he saw an official waiting in a carriage. After half a day of bumps, the carriage stopped in Shitan Town, Zhaozhou.
Although the princess has a bit of a sweet and willful personality, Li Jin is really not a bad person. In addition to handing over the banknotes on the boat, he also helped Zaoer and his father prepare a small house. There was a small open space next to the house. When they first arrived, Zaoer thought that he was back home again.
It's just that there is one place that is completely different. Here in Zhaozhou, there is no Long Yan that she deeply loves.
In Shitan Town, Zaoer and her father make a living selling dumplings and noodle soup. Although she didn't have much money with her when she left the city, relying on the skills learned from "one-stop service", the two of them saved some money, enough to buy some seeds and hoes in the town for home cultivation. In this way, the income gradually became more abundant.
At this moment, I saw her squatting in front of a large bush of shepherd's purse, her hands like flying butterflies, pinching and picking twigs of shepherd's purse, and soon the basket was full. The sound of her father's face being tossed could be heard in the room. Her lips curled up slightly, and then she suppressed her smile.
"I wonder if Mr. Long and Princess... get along well?"
She scooped up a ladle of water and poured it on the muddy ground, loosened the shepherd's purse she had just messed up with her fingers, and then moved to the next patch of vegetables.
Half a year has passed, and Zao'er is squinting as she looks into the distant woods. When she recalls her last night with Long Yan, she still sheds tears on her pillow. She once hoped that that night would make her pregnant with Long Yan's child, but perhaps because she was unlucky, God did not show such a miracle to her.
"No matter what, I hope they are happy, especially Mr. Long, who can open his heart and accept the princess."
Although the princess's marriage was a big event in the world, Zao'er had always assumed that Long Yan was married to Princess Puning, and never thought of other possibilities. In addition, Shitan Town was secluded and small, and there were not many outsiders, so no one knew what new news there was in Beijing.
Shitan Town is very nice, with friendly neighbors and a quiet environment. She wants to live here for the rest of her life and there will be no problem. Even if yearning strikes her occasionally, she will grit her teeth and get through it with the help of her past and the love words Long Yan told her before.
At this moment, a magnificent carriage rolled into Shitan Town. Every time Long Yan passed a road, he would come down to inquire if there was a father and daughter named Shi nearby. They moved here about half a year ago, and there were not many people in the town. He immediately found out where Zaoer and her father lived.
When Shi Laolu, who was throwing noodles in the house, heard that the noodles were being thrown in the carriage, he thought it was because the guests eating gnocchi and dumplings had arrived early, so he immediately put his head in and shouted -
"The waiter isn't here yet!" But when he saw the visitor, his eyes widened suddenly. He, he, he... wasn't he dazzled? "Master Long?!"
"Why do you still call me that?" Long Yan bowed respectfully to Father Shi. "You should have changed your name and called meLong Yan. "
Shi Laolu cried and laughed, and was about to point his finger at the vegetable garden next to the house, but when he thought of the princess, he immediately held onto Long Yan tightly. "Answer me first, you and the princess..."
"The emperor has already betrothed the princess to someone else, so my father-in-law can rest assured that the seat next to my son-in-law has been reserved for Zao'er. "
"Okay, okay, it's not in vain that our daughter has been crying for you for half a year..." Shi Laolu wiped away his tears. "Our dumpling stall is closed today and we are all at your command. "
Long Yan pressed Father Shi's hands and immediately ran to the vegetable garden.
Zao'er, who was concentrating on pulling weeds, didn't realize there was anyone behind her until she realized someone was looking at her. She was about to turn around when a pair of iron arms hugged her tightly.
This smell, this feeling... Zaoer closed her eyes suddenly. She thought she must have made a mistake. The person next to her couldn't be him, it couldn't be Long Yan!
"My date. "Excited Long Yan whispered against her cheek: "Do you know how hard I have thought of you in the past six months? "
"It's really you..." Her first reaction was to hug him, but when she remembered the agreement with the princess, she hurriedly broke away with all her strength.
Don't get close to him. If the princess finds out, he will be harmed! Zaoer backed away with tears in her eyes.
"I'm not married to the princess, silly Zao'er, why do you think I can let you go? "
No? ! Her eyes widened. However, the princess did mention to her at that time that she had to marry him...
"The emperor has betrothed the princess to someone else..." He took a step forward and hugged her tightly again, and in a dumb voice recounted roughly what had happened in the past six months. "...In addition to the agreement with Li Jin, I have also been writing letters asking chefs in restaurants and inns to help keep an eye on you. But how did I know that you, a little guy, also opened a small restaurant of your own? "[Hot
"I don't want to forget what you taught me! "Knowing that Princess Puning was no longer a threat to the two of them, she hugged him tightly and cried loudly. The longing and sadness that had been accumulated for half a year burst out, and she couldn't hold back her tears at all.
"Come back to Beijing with me. He held her face and pecked her face. It was hard to tell whose tears were stained on the face. "You promised me that you would never leave me in this life. I want you to fulfill your promise. You must marry me." "
"Okay, okay, I promise you whatever you say..."
As she murmured in agreement, Long Yan picked her up in his arms.
“Follow me to the inn where I’m staying. He smiled at the tearful Zaoer and said, "What I want to do next is not suitable for your father to catch me." "
"My dad..." She was just thinking about what to say to her dad. When she turned around, she saw her dad waving at the door.
"There is no business today, so you can go wherever you want, the old man has no objection. "
Hearing her father shout this, they both laughed at the same time.
On the carriage that came all the way to the inn, Long Yan added a lot of details. Especially the day she left Zhaozhou all night, he went crazy.
"The past six months have been hard on you. ” She stroked his cheek.
"You are the one who is really suffering, why do you have to bear so many things secretly alone? If your father hadn't known to leave me a message, maybe we would still be separated from each other and not allowed to see each other. "
"I'm thinking about the princess. If she really gets married to you today, it would be very bad if you are still thinking about me. "
"Fool. He pretended to be angry and pinched her nose gently. "I only worry about the princess and me. What about yourself?" "
"I can't find any other better way! "She hugged his neck and cried. "You don't know that day, I heard Mr. Li say that you were locked up by the princess, and I felt so sad. "
"Are you thinking of me when I was a child? "He rubbed her face gently.
She sobbed and nodded. "I can't protect you when you were a child, but at least I can make the grown-ups suffer less..."
He hugged her slim waist tightly. This girl always made him feel sad and pitiful.
"I'm sorry. "She sincerely apologized. "I said at the beginning that I would never treat you wrong again.You lied, but that night, I did it anyway. "
“There is no basis for what you say. " He stared into her eyes and kissed the tears on her cheeks. "I want you to use your actual performance to compensate for the pain of missing me for the past six months..."
She dared to kiss his mouth, and she could still hear her vague murmur: "In the past six months, I have been thinking about the night we spent together... It's really, so lonely..."
"Me too. " He pressed his forehead against hers.
In the past six months, every time he couldn't sleep at night, he would think about Zhu's coquettishness and willfulness, Li Jin's stubbornness, and his original ignorance and recklessness. But as time passed, he gradually learned to show harshness to others, leaving only his love and compassion for Zaoer.
